name: Dray Sap Waterfall
summary: A day at the wide sheet on the Serepok, in primary forest in Dak Sor, Krong No. UNESCO describes the drop as about 100 metres across and about 12 metres down. The provincial handbook puts it about 110 km from Gia Nghia, so skip it if Ta Dung already has the morning. The gate price is Check on arrival.
getThere: About 110 km from Gia Nghia, in Krong No
heroCaption: The wide sheet of Dray Sap, with forest along the cliff
bestMonths: May to October for a fuller cascade

notice.title: Not a same-morning add-on
notice.body: The provincial handbook puts Dray Sap about 110 km from Gia Nghia. Do not pair it with a Ta Dung boat morning.

body: Walk the viewpoints over the wide sheet. UNESCO describes a cascade about 100 metres across and about 12 metres down, in primary forest. The Dak Nong provincial handbook names Gia Long and Trinh Nu in the same cluster, in Dak Sor, Krong No. Give the site the middle of the day. How long you stay on the paths is Check on arrival.

The gate price is Check on arrival. Neither the provincial handbook nor UNESCO prints a ticket price. Foody lists the cluster as open 07:30–18:00. That listing is not the ticket office, so read the board when you arrive. The mistake is treating the falls as a short hop after the lake.

figures.caption: The full width from the river, framed by the forest
figures.alt: Dray Sap waterfall across the Serepok, seen through trees on both sides

gettingThere: The eco-site is in Dak Sor, Krong No. The provincial handbook puts it about 110 km from Gia Nghia. Hire a car or a motorbike. The minutes are Check on arrival. Travelers who fly into Buon Ma Thuot often approach from that side of the Serepok. The handbook does not print the kilometres from the airport to the gate.

legs.heading: From Gia Nghia
legs.body: About 110 km by road, on the provincial handbook. Hire a car or a motorbike. The minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Buon Ma Thuot
legs.body: Buon Ma Thuot is the usual flight. The road then runs toward Krong No. The handbook puts Gia Nghia about 125 km from Buon Ma Thuot, and Bao Lam Dong puts that road at about 135 km. Neither page prints the kilometres from the airport to the Dray Sap gate. Check on arrival.

closed: The provincial handbook does not print a weekly closing day. Read the gate board on arrival.
admissionNote: No ticket price is printed in the Dak Nong provincial handbook or on the UNESCO geopark page. Check on arrival. Child, senior, and inclusion rules are Check on arrival.
